_comment: Terrain types, per brief section 24. Terrain must meaningfully affect
battles and must be data-driven, so every rule lives here rather than in
'symbol' is the character used in a battle's terrain grid, which keeps
battle files readable and diffable at a glance.
move_cost is in movement points. 'blocked' means impassable except for the

terrain.name: Grass
terrain.notes: The baseline. Everything else is measured against this.

terrain.name: Road
terrain.notes: Cheap movement. Distinct from grass so mounted and wheeled units can be discounted later without touching every map.

terrain.name: Forest
terrain.notes: Brief section 24: higher cost for some units, defence bonus.

terrain.name: Rocks
terrain.notes: Scatter cover on the North Meadow field.

terrain.name: Hill
terrain.notes: Height 1. The goblin archer takes this in battle 01 to teach ranged positioning.

terrain.name: Fence
terrain.notes: Blocks ground movement, not sight. Shapes the approach in battle 01.

terrain.name: Rubble
terrain.notes: Created when the Crownwall collapses in battle 02.

terrain.name: Crownwall
terrain.notes: Absolutely impassable, including for flying units. Turn-3 events convert specific wall tiles to rubble.

terrain.name: Obstacle
terrain.notes: Generic solid prop: the overturned cart, the guard post, a building corner.

terrain.name: Escape tile
terrain.notes: Used by escape objectives and by the fleeing goblin spearman in battle 01.
